alpha_species.distribution_status: parametric sensitivity family; not a measured LAPD or p-B11 fusion-product distribution
alpha_species.model: gyrotropic ring; lognormal perpendicular energy; Maxwellian parallel velocity
alpha_species.quadrature: Gauss-Hermite in log-energy; analytic Z and Z-prime integration over parallel Maxwellian

collision_operator_status.reason: No collisional damping is inserted in this release. A frequency-shifted pole or a constant-nu substitution is not a conserving Coulomb collision operator. The required full magnetized linearized Landau test-particle plus field-particle operator has to be discretized and checked for particle, momentum, energy conservation and non-negative entropy production before use.
required_validation: discrete momentum conservation across coupled species
discrete total kinetic-energy conservation across coupled species
recovery of collisionless v1.3 as collision frequency tends to zero

limitations: The 24 keV LAPD alpha ring is a laboratory reference, not the approximately MeV-scale alpha birth distribution of p-B11 fusion.
The alpha distribution is a tunable gyrotropic ring family, not a reaction-derived slowing-down distribution.
The model is electrostatic, homogeneous and local; no finite geometry, gradients, electromagnetic coupling or wave escape is included.
Finite-kparallel Landau phase mixing is collisionless and is not collisional thermalization.
No nonlinear saturation, proton irreversible heating, fusion gain, net electricity, cost or commercial claim is established.
references: An introduction to perpendicularly propagating Bernstein waves, Phys. Plasmas (2026), Harris oblique electrostatic dispersion relation: https://doi.org/10.1063/5.0316617
Pan & Ernst (2019), Phys. Rev. E 99, 023201, conservative gyrokinetic Landau operator: https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevE.99.023201

thermal_species.model: Maxwellian Harris susceptibility with all retained cyclotron harmonics

title: PARC-Delta v1.3 finite-parallel-wavenumber kinetic IBW extension
